text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The black market rate of the German mark has gone up to 27.60 denars and will go to 28 denars.

- Negotiations for the succession of the former Yugoslavia will be under EU authoritiy and international mediator Sir Arthur Watts is trying to achieve some progress before the beginning of the London Conference.

- Macedonia plans to build a third airport in Strumica, southeast of Skopje. A feasibility study is being prepared by the Turkish company Burc. The company is ready to finance the construction of the airport together with Macedonian government and the local company Asterlon.

- U.N. Secretary General Boutros Boutros-Ghali's proposal to reduce the number of UNPREDEP troops in Macedonia is a compromise to Russian pressure. The proposal heralds the imminent withdrawal of the prevention force and raises the question of whether Macedonia can subsist without an international umbrella. -- Skopje newsroom, 389 91 201 196
